newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Latam steadies, Euro ADRs softer.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Latam steadies, Euro ADRs softer.

text.p: Latin American shares stayed firm in New York on Thursday as European American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) weakened with the larger market, traders said.

Brazilian state telecom Telebras was hit by a Brazilian judge's ruling that a 1990 subscription offer by the company was valid. Telebras also has been hurt recently by speculation its nine-month earnings would be below forecasts.
"People are shifting their money out of Telebras into electricity and (mining giant) Companhia Vale do Rio Doce," said Lucia Skwarek, head of Latin American equities trading for UBS Securities.
Mexican stocks were bolstered by a stronger peso and bullish expectations for Telefonos de Mexico earnings, expected out on Thursday. The company's ADR rose 1/8 to 31-1/2.
Argentine telecom Telefonica de Argentina remained unchanged at 22-7/8.

Among European ADRs, Dutch software company Baan Co NV rose 2-5/8 to 39-1/8 on improved third-quarter earnings. Norway's Petroleum Geo-Services A/S was up 1-1/2 to 35 on a jump in nine-month earnings.
In late morning, 90 of a selected index of 441 ADRs had advanced and 150 had dropped. Volume was 19.8 million shares.
